items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: See, this is great, because you know your life by this. This is better than my birth certificate. I can’t count on anybody else that knows. You know what I’m saying?
I feel like Ralph Edwards. He Loved Him Madly is June 19th or 20th, ’74.

Okay, that’s within a month after Duke. So we’re in Brazil in May, and he – because Duke died, whatever night that was, or day – who knows? It could have been three days until we found out. He said – we were on the bandstand. Afterwards, he said, “Duke died.” I said, “Whoa.” He said, “Got to do something for him.” Then, that’s what we did. He Loved Him Madly.
